claims: Assess and manage anemia with serial hemoglobin/hematocrit monitoring and evaluate need for transfusion or bleeding source.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor oxygenation/ventilation via arterial blood gases and pulse oximetry.
Monitor and titrate vasoactive infusions (nitroglycerin, phenylephrine) and maintain hemodynamic stability with arterial line and central venous pressure monitoring.
Continue insulin infusion with glucose monitoring and titration to maintain glycemic control.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen, platelets) and assess for bleeding or need for reversal given recent protamine and fibrinogen levels.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, monitoring response and respiratory status.
Maintain sedation per target RASS, monitoring depth of sedation and adjusting sedative infusions as needed.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, calcium, sodium) and renal function, replacing deficits as indicated.
Provide oral care and secretion management, including subglottic suctioning and chlorhexidine rinse, to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
Assess and manage volume status with diuretics as indicated, monitoring urine output, weight, and hemodynamics.
